in_hebrew.name: רוחית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Windy in Hebrew is derived from the Hebrew word רוח (ruach), which means 'wind' or 'breath'. The suffix -ית (-yit) is added to form a feminine noun, resulting in רוחית (ruachit), which means 'gentle breeze'.

in_greek.name: Ανεμοσύνη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Windy in Greek is derived from the Greek word ανεμός (anemos), which means 'wind'. The suffix -σύνη (-synē) is added to form a feminine noun, resulting in Ανεμοσύνη (anemosynē), which means 'graceful wind'.

in_latin.name: Ventosa
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Windy in Latin is derived from the Latin word ventus, which means 'wind'. The suffix -osa is added to form a feminine noun, resulting in Ventosa, which means 'windy'.
